title: Rappler Live Jam: XONARA
summary: Catch the fast-rising P-pop girl group make its Rappler Live Jam debut!

blocks.text: Catch the fast-rising P-pop girl group make its Rappler Live Jam debut!
MANILA, Philippines – Months after making its resounding debut, rising P-pop girl group XONARA takes the Rappler Live Jam stage on Thursday, November 12!

Composed of members Eurekah, Namie, Ella, Dominique, Megumi, Lei, and Tin, XONARA debuted in May 2026 under 1Z Entertainment. The septet prides itself on championing its individual members’ voices while maintaining a harmonious musical identity as a group.
XONARA first burst onto the scene with the high-powered single “TABI,” and then dropped the R&B-leaning “PULA” in August.
Now, the rising P-pop girl group is back with a fresh release, “IMPERFECT,” which promotes self-love over the desire to give in to impossible expectations.
Catch XONARA on Rappler Live Jam on Thursday at 8 pm by bookmarking this page or heading to Rappler’s YouTube! – Rappler.com
